decisions.reason: A multi-model formwork profile line with its own web page is a visible commitment close to the core offer, so dropping it would write off the investment and expose the launch decision.
The automated concrete distributor control embodies the firm's announced automation direction and its own R&D investment, so management will persist with it.
The shuttering magnet block line is cheap to maintain within the established formwork business, and nothing in its results argues for dropping it.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line presented on their own page, a public commitment central to the magnetic formwork range.
This component was visibly committed to with its own page and fits the core magnetic formwork range, so it is retained.
This component has had little investment and only a website mention, so it is the easiest to drop, but it fits the expanding core range and has no clear failure.
